title: Payment Terms
intro: These terms outline how projects are billed, paid, and delivered. They exist to ensure clarity, protect both parties, and keep projects moving smoothly.

sections.title: Project Deposits
sections.body: All projects require a non-refundable deposit of 40–50% before work begins.
bullets: No work is started without a deposit
Deposits secure scheduling and project time

sections.title: Milestone Payments
sections.body: For larger or multi-phase projects, remaining balances may be divided into milestones.
bullets: Milestones are agreed upon in advance
Each milestone must be paid before proceeding

sections.title: Final Payment
sections.body: The final balance is due before launch, deployment, or delivery of final files.
bullets: Websites are launched only after payment is complete

sections.title: Accepted Payment Methods
sections.body: Payments are accepted via secure online invoice using credit or debit card.

sections.title: Late Payments
sections.body: Invoices not paid within 5 calendar days of the due date may result in paused work and delayed timelines.

sections.title: Refund Policy
sections.body: Due to the custom nature of services, all payments are non-refundable once work has begun. Deposits are non-refundable under all circumstances.

sections.title: Chargebacks & Disputes
sections.body: Clients agree to contact Jyvenche directly before initiating a chargeback or payment dispute. Unauthorized chargebacks may result in service termination and loss of access to deliverables.

sections.title: Agreement to Terms
sections.body: Submitting payment confirms acceptance of these payment terms and the associated project agreement.
